description.title: שירות רכב חלופי
description.summary: This table outlines the terms of service for an alternative vehicle provided during the insurance period. It details the availability of the service center and the rights and obligations of the insured and the service provider.
description.embed_passage: מסמך זה מהווה את מסמך השירות בין המבוטח לספק שירות הרכב החלופי המצוין בפירוט, אשר במהלך תקופת הביטוח יקיים תקשורת יעילה וזמינה. מסמך השירות מפרט את השירותים להם זכאי המבוטח, הזכויות והחובות ההדדיות של המבוטח ושל ספק השירות. מוקד השירות יהיה זמין בימים ראשון עד חמישי, בין השעות 08:00 ל-17:00, בימי שישי וערבי חג בין השעות 08:00 ל-13:00 וערב יום כיפור בין השעות 08:00 ל-12:00. שירות רכב חלופי זה רלוונטי כאשר 'מסמך שירות רכב חלופי' מצוין בפירוט כבעל תוקף. מוקד השירות, ספק השירות, המבוטח, תקופת הביטוח.
description.column_axis: Details of service availability and terms
notable_values: Service center availability: Yom Kippur eve 08:00-12:00

sketch:
If expressly noted in the specification that the 'ALTERNATIVE VEHICLE SERVICE DOCUMENT"
is valid, then the following service document provisions shall apply:
This document constitutes the service document between the insured and the alternative vehicle service provider noted in the specification (hereinafter for abbreviation purposes the "service provider") which, in the course of the insurance period will conduct efficient and available communication. This service document details the services to which the insured is entitled, the mutual rights and obligations of the insured and the service provider.
The service center will be available from Sunday to Thursday, from 08:00 to 17:00, on Fridays and holiday eves from 08:00 to 13:00 and on the eve of Yom Kippur from 08:00 to 12:00.

טבלה: שירות רכב חלופי
This table outlines the terms of service for an alternative vehicle provided during the insurance period. It details the availability of the service center and the rights and obligations of the insured and the service provider.
ממדים: Service document provisions, Details of service availability and terms

If expressly noted in the specification that the 'ALTERNATIVE VEHICLE SERVICE DOCUMENT"
is valid, then the following service document provisions shall apply:
This document constitutes the service document between the insured and the alternative vehicle service provider noted in the specification (hereinafter for abbreviation purposes the "service provider") which, in the course of the insurance period will conduct efficient and available communication. This service document details the services to which the insured is entitled, the mutual rights and obligations of the insured and the service provider.
The service center will be available from Sunday to Thursday, from 08:00 to 17:00, on Fridays and holiday eves from 08:00 to 13:00 and on the eve of Yom Kippur from 08:00 to 12:00.
